Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.coveragestore

Class CoverageStoreManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.coveragestore.CoverageStoreManager
public class CoverageStoreManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer CoverageStore REST API manager.

A CoverageStore defines a raster spatial data source in the GeoServer catalog. It supports raster formats such as GeoTIFF, ImageMosaic, and WorldImage. Each CoverageStore belongs to a specific workspace and can contain one or more Coverages. The file upload API allows uploading a raster file to the server and simultaneously creating the store and coverage.

Endpoints

 GET     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores
 GET     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores/{storeName}
 POST    /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores
 PUT     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores/{storeName}
 DELETE  /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores/{storeName}
 PUT     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores/{storeName}/{method}.{format}
 POST    /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/coveragestores/{storeName}/{method}.{format}

    • create

      public CoverageStore create(String workspaceName, CreateCoverageStoreRequest request)
      Create a new coverage store.

      The POST body automatically includes workspace.name (required — omitting causes GeoServer 500).

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      request - creation parameters (required, name is required)
      Returns:
      created coverage store (GET after POST)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName/request is null/empty
      ResourceAlreadyExistsException - if a coverage store with the same name already exists

      request - update parameters (required, at least one field required)
      Returns:

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, boolean recurse)
      Delete a coverage store with purge=none.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, also deletes all coverages and layers; when false, store must be empty — otherwise returns 403.

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, boolean recurse, String purge)
      Delete a coverage store with explicit recurse and purge options.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, also deletes all coverages and layers
      purge - file deletion policy: "none" (default, keep files), "metadata" (delete metadata only), "all" (delete all files). Effective only for ImageMosaic (StructuredGridCoverage2DReader).
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName or storeName is null/empty
      CoverageStoreNotFoundException - if no coverage store with the given name exists (404)

    • uploadFile

      public void uploadFile(String workspaceName, String storeName, String method, String format, File file)
      Upload a raster file to create or update a coverage store. Runs with configure=none (no auto-coverage). 
       // Upload a GeoTIFF (store only, no coverage)
 manager.uploadFile("myws", "mystore", "file", "geotiff", tifFile)
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name (required)
      method - upload method: "file" (inline), "url" (remote URL), "external" (server path)
      format - file format: "geotiff", "worldimage", "imagemosaic", "arcgrid", etc.
      file - file to upload
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if any required parameter is null/empty

    • uploadFile

      public void uploadFile(String workspaceName, String storeName, String method, String format, File file, String configure, String coverageName, String filename)
      Upload a raster file to create or update a coverage store (with options).
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name (required)
      method - "file", "url", "external"
      format - "geotiff", "worldimage", "imagemosaic", "arcgrid", etc.
      file - file to upload
      configure - auto-coverage mode: "none" (default, store only), "first", "all"
      coverageName - coverage name to create (null uses storeName)
      filename - target filename on server (null uses original filename)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if any required parameter is null/empty
